faq.a: A continent is one of the seven very large areas of land on Earth: Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe and Australia. Each one holds many countries, except Antarctica, which has none.

faq.q: How many countries are in Africa?
faq.a: Africa has 54 countries in the United Nations, more than any other continent. Nigeria has the most people of any African country.
asks: Which African country has the most people?

faq.a: Lagos is on the coast of south-west Nigeria, beside the Atlantic Ocean in West Africa. It is the biggest city in Nigeria and one of the biggest in Africa.
asks: What is the biggest city in Nigeria?

faq.q: Why do addresses go from small to big?
faq.a: An address starts with your house and street, then your town and country, so a letter can be sorted from the whole world down to your door. Each step makes the area smaller.

faq.q: What is the difference between a city and a country?
faq.a: A country is a large area with its own borders and government, like Nigeria or Brazil. A city is one big town inside a country, like Lagos or São Paulo.
asks: Is a city bigger than a country?

facts: Africa has 54 countries that are members of the United Nations.
Nigeria has the largest population in Africa, over 200 million people.
Lagos was Nigeria's capital until 1991, when the capital moved to Abuja.

quiz.say: Which list goes from smallest to biggest?
quiz.why: A street is inside a city, and a city is inside a country.

wrong.1: A country is bigger than a city, so it cannot come first.
wrong.2: A street is smaller than a city, so it comes before it.

quiz.say: Lagos is a city. Which country is it in?
quiz.why: Lagos is the biggest city in Nigeria, in West Africa.

wrong.1: Kenya is in East Africa; its biggest city is Nairobi.
wrong.2: Egypt is in North Africa; its biggest city is Cairo.
